resource.name: aws_kinesis_stream_consumer
resource.description: Provides a resource to manage a Kinesis Stream Consumer. You can register up to 20 consumers per stream. A given consumer can only be registered with one stream at a time. For more details, see the Amazon Kinesis Stream Consumer Documentation.
resource.llm_summary: The `aws_kinesis_stream_consumer` resource enables the management and registration of Kinesis Data Stream consumers, facilitating real-time data processing and analytics by applications. It is commonly used to configure consumer applications for scalable stream consumption, ensuring efficient integration with a specific Kinesis stream. Key configurations include lifecycle management, stream association, and support for up to 20 consumers per stream, making it ideal for scenarios requiring high-throughput data ingestion and processing pipelines.

examples.title: Basic Usage
examples.llm_summary: "Demonstrates the basic setup of an AWS Kinesis Stream Consumer using the `aws_kinesis_stream_consumer` resource, including linking it to a Kinesis stream via the `stream_arn` argument. This example helps users understand how to create a consumer for processing data from a Kinesis stream."

arguments.name: id
arguments.llm_summary: The `id` argument for the `aws_kinesis_stream_consumer` resource represents the unique identifier of the Kinesis stream consumer. While typically managed by Terraform and not required to be explicitly set, it can be used to reference or track the consumer resource for integration with other infrastructure components or for troubleshooting purposes.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: (Required, Forces new resource) Name of the stream consumer.
arguments.llm_summary: The `name` argument specifies the unique identifier for the Kinesis stream consumer, allowing users to define and distinguish the consumer within the associated stream. Setting this argument ensures the creation of a new resource and is critical for enabling the consumer to process data from the stream, aligning with user goals of managing data ingestion pipelines effectively.

arguments.name: stream_arn
arguments.description: – (Required, Forces new resource) Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the data stream the consumer is registered with.
arguments.llm_summary: The `stream_arn` argument specifies the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Kinesis data stream that the consumer will be associated with, enabling the consumer to read and process data from the specified stream. This required parameter establishes the linkage between the consumer and its source stream, ensuring proper data flow and integration for real-time analytics or event-driven applications.

attributes.name: arn
attributes.description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the stream consumer.

attributes.name: creation_timestamp
attributes.description: Approximate timestamp in RFC3339 format of when the stream consumer was created.
